 Follow KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour coming to downtown Indy
 Zachary Jones Fri, November 13, 2026 at 2:25 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. AEG and Netflix The next generation of K-pop concert experiences is coming to the Circle City!
 Netflix and AEG just announced that Huntr/x will be performing in Gainbridge Fieldhouse next summer. On Wednesday, June 23, the KPop Demon Hunters "Golden World Tour" will make a stop in Indianapolis.
 General tickets go on sale to the public Friday, Nov. 20 at 10 a.m. Presale options are available for Mastercard holders starting Wednesday, Nov.18.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here's how the show is described by the companies :
 "Powered by songs from Netflix's most popular film of all time, beloved animated HUNTR/X characters – Rumi, Mira and Zoey – will interact with the audience through cutting-edge performance innovations that bring this fan-favorite K-pop girl group to life like never before (yes, that also includes the animated characters of the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger). Every fan in attendance will play a part to show the world How It's Done, Done, Done! More than a concert, this is a first-of-its-kind production that immerses fans in the storytelling with live-action stunts and performers, fan-favorite music and choreography, and special performances."
